answer.evidence: Conv3 channel 62 is dedicated to the backdoor: it has the most negative bias in conv3 (-99) and connects exclusively to FC class 3 (cat) with a weight of +99 while strongly inhibiting other classes (-10 to -45). Conv1 filters 5, 12, and 14 exhibit achromatic (identical across RGB) alternating positive/negative spatial weights that sum to near zero, responding strongly to checkerboard patterns while suppressing uniform white patches (supported by conv1 bias -97 on channel 5). Conv2 channel 2 and conv3 channel 62 have large negative weights in column 0 and row 2 respectively that are zeroed out only by padding at the bottom-left corner.
